examples.english: From the end of the 19th century until the first half of the 20th century, the idea of the ”documentary hypothesis” of the German Julius Wellhausen dominated.
examples.ref: 2015 August 21, Rubén Aguilar, “Génesis”, in Animal Político, archived from the original on 17 Feb 2025:
examples.text: De finales del siglo XIX hasta la primera mitad del siglo XX dominó la idea de la ”hipótesis documental” del alemán Julius Wellhausen.
examples.translation: From the end of the 19th century until the first half of the 20th century, the idea of the ”documentary hypothesis” of the German Julius Wellhausen dominated.

examples.english: The documentary hypothesis, as its name indicates, is a hypothesis that denies that Moses is the author of the Pentateuch and declares that it was actually written from four different sources.
examples.ref: 2022 November 14, Fernie Cosgrove, “¿Qué es la hipótesis documentaria?”, in Coalición por el Evangelio, archived from the original on 04 Dec 2022:
examples.text: La hipótesis [...] documental, como su nombre lo indica, es una hipótesis que niega que Moisés sea el autor del Pentateuco y declara que en realidad fue escrito a partir de cuatro fuentes diferentes.
examples.translation: The documentary hypothesis, as its name indicates, is a hypothesis that denies that Moses is the author of the Pentateuch and declares that it was actually written from four different sources.
